Noah: Morning quickfire: single-word mood check — one word only, no explanations. Go.
Zara: caffeinated
Kai: optimistic
Jules: tired
Noah: risky one-word combo: caffeinated + optimistic = caffeptimistic? :thinking_face:
Zara: leave the portmanteaus to the weekend. :laughing: but I support caffeptimistic.
LunchBot: LunchBot: Free bagels in the kitchen at 11:45! First come, first served.
Kai: bagels > sleep :bagel:
Jules: anyone want to start a micro-ritual: slice bagel, declare one tiny win aloud?
Noah: love that. tiny-win ritual accepted. I'll start: 'I fixed the flakey test.' :confetti_ball:
Zara: I'll follow: 'I deleted an old feature flag' :sparkles:
Kai: 'I shipped a tiny improvement' :rocket:
Jules: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/ta-da-celebrate-3o6ZtaO9BZHcOjmErm
Noah: OK official: bagel ritual at 11:50. Bring one-line wins. No threadlong bragging. :grimacing:
Zara: also proposing a silly rule: if you miss ritual, you owe the team a meme. Fair? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Kai: fair and enforceable. I'll add a sticky note tracker.
Jules: tally: mood words = [caffeinated, optimistic, tired], ritual = yes, memes = collateral. See you at bagels.
Noah: thread locked for hype. See y'all! :hand-wave:
